value_or_null.description: LN229 carries most functional/migration work, with U87 additional foci/RT survival. T98G has functional NMDA-response context, LN428 was tested without equivalent positive response. Not all four lines underwent all endpoints; no animal or patient efficacy experiment.

Figure1 caption uses100uM Glu/10uM glycine whereas methods uses1mM/100uM. This tenfold source discrepancy remains unresolved. Both use20s application and10uM ionomycin90s. Roughly50% calcium-responsive and40% current-responsive are cell observations, not population prevalence.

Patch-clamp agonists100uM NMDA/AMPA/kainate, n22 meanSEM; GluN1/2A/2B immunostaining and lamellipodial localization do not prove memantine-specific necessary downstream pathways or quantitative receptor-subtype superiority.

Figure2 MTT48h compares Glu1mM/MK80110uM/ifenprodil25uM, at least5 experiments each octuplet. Do not transfer those MK801/ifenprodil MTT effects to memantine. Methods MTT description mentions memantine/MK801; no invented memantine MTT group estimate.

LN229 glutamate release about7.8ug/mL/h from3.5e5 cells, blocked SAS250uM. Cell-cycle24h Glu/MK801/SAS differences null; ifenprodil small G1 increase. Autocrine explanation is plausible without proof all viability effects are receptor-specific.

LN229 gap closure48h with memantine50uM or ifenprodil25uM versus Glu1mM,3 experiments each triplicate. This is a cell-covered-area assay, not independent in-vivo invasion/metastasis, and reduced cell growth/survival can affect gap closure.
Memantine drug-only clonogenic LD50 is26+/-11uM meanSEM n3; MK801 .9+/-1.1uM text. Seven-day colony endpoint is distinct from MTT48h and clinical drug dosing; no human PK/selectivity evidence.

Figure3A gives29+/-5 to7+/-2 foci at4h after2Gy n3 P<.01 with Glu1mM, but source calls comparator mock-irradiated despite2Gy context and both plot groups labeled2Gy. Preserve ambiguity, do not invent a proven0Gy comparison. Foci are DNA-damage markers, not direct measurement of all repair pathways.

Figure3D memantine50uM radiation enhancement factor at2Gy1.4, n3 SD; ifenprodil1.81 is text context, not an extra displayed memantine curve. Figure4 CFA instead uses25uM memantine and1uM KG501; no dose pooling or clinical therapeutic index.

pCREB30min relative3.7+/-1.1 P<.05 n3, antibody also recognizes pATF1. BDNF1.9+/-.15-fold P<.05 n3, comparator SAS250uM; MK80110uM results versus20uM BDNF methods remains unresolved. Single representative blot labels3.9/1.3/1.9 differ from replicate means, not replacements for summary estimates.

Body says both MK801/KG501 significantly increase gammaH2AX after30min irradiation; Figure4B says4h post2Gy, MK8011.4+/-.3 NS, KG5011.8+/-.4 P<.05 n3. Retain MK801 null and timing inconsistency; do not promote both to significant.

Figure3 foci use EdU-positive S/G2; Figure4 EdU-negative non-S phase LN229/U87, memantine100uM/KG50125uM,0.5h/4h after2Gy, n3 SEM. More residual4h foci and slight/no0.5h effects are phase/time-specific, not all conditions equally affected.

Figure4 CFA uses memantine25uM/KG5011uM: LN229 n3 triplets, U87 n2 triplets, SD. Memantine reduces survival starting2Gy; U87 KG501 also does, but combined treatment has no significant further survival effect. Foci effects subadditive. No synergy or independently replicated causal pathway proof.

Technical octuplets/triplicates and150-200 nuclei per point are nested observations. General meanSEM n>=3 has explicit U87 CFA n2/SD exception. Some figure3 significance-key labels are internally unusual; preserve reported thresholds without inventing exact P/CI. Protocol/raw data/randomization/blinding/power not independently checked.

Drug perturbation, receptor currents and pCREB support a model; gammaH2AX persistence is a surrogate and no genetic rescue/direct downstream target program establishes complete necessity. Authors state how NMDAR-CREB affects survival/IR remains elusive. Animal/phaseI/melanoma/AML examples are cited background, not own data.

Proposed radiosensitizing adjuvant rationale is preclinical. No normal-brain comparator, therapeutic index, clinical GBM benefit, human brain exposure or dosing recommendation. Source FDA-approved class/drug wording and cited phaseI status are not current regulatory/trial verification.
